Power simulation for Solomon designs

Source: R/solomon_core.R
power_solomon.Rd

Power simulation for Solomon designs

Usage

power_solomon(
  n = list(n1 = 50, n2 = 50, n3 = 50, n4 = 50),
  delta = 0.3,
  rho = 0.5,
  sens = 0,
  sigma = 1,
  sims = 2000,
  stouffer = TRUE
)

Arguments

n

list with n1..n4 per cell (or a single n per cell)

delta

average treatment effect (on posttest scale)

rho

correlation(pre, post) in pretested cells

sens

pretest sensitization add-on to treatment in pretested cells (0 = none)

sigma

SD of errors

sims

number of Monte Carlo replicates

stouffer

Logical; if TRUE, also estimate power for the optional Stouffer meta-analytic procedure.

Value

data.frame with estimated power for: interaction, ATE, simple effects, and (optionally) Stouffer Z
